sections.title: Confront the Past
sections.description: The past you tried to bury crashes through your office door. Dominic White—the White Rabbit who haunts your nightmares—stands before you, accused of kidnapping Alice Dinner. Every question cuts deeper than the last. Can you face the truth without losing yourself? Your children are waiting. Don't let them down.

sections.title: Intellectual Duel in Search of the Truth
sections.description: Feel the tension as you break down suspects' defenses. Every word matters—choose Anger to intimidate, Fear to manipulate, Hope to redeem. Watch them crack under pressure as you expose their lies. The satisfaction of forcing a confession is addictive, but each victory comes at a cost. How far will you go for the truth?

sections.title: You're Not Crazy Rabbit
sections.description: Everyone lies. Everyone hides something. In this Wonderland gone mad, you'll question your own sanity as you face characters who blur the line between friend and monster. The dark humor keeps you laughing through the tears, but the tragedy never lets you forget—nothing is as it seems, and trust is the most dangerous weapon of all.

sections.title: You Can't Forget Who You Were
sections.description: Case 2 isn't just another file—it's the moment everything changes. Your past shadows every choice, every revelation cuts deeper. The conspiracy you uncover will shatter your reality. Are you ready to learn who you really are? The truth waits in the darkness. Will you dare to face it?
